class.name: Mission
class.brief_description: Mission with objectives, time limits, and status tracking.
class.description: Manages mission lifecycle: objectives, insertion/extraction points, time limits, and success/failure conditions. Emits signals on state transitions.

method.name: start_mission
method.description: Starts the mission. Transitions from PENDING to IN_PROGRESS.

method.name: complete_current_objective
method.description: Marks the current objective as completed and advances to the next.

method.name: add_objective
method.description: Adds a new objective to the mission.

method.name: has_objectives
method.description: Returns true if the mission has any objectives.

method.name: all_objectives_completed
method.description: Returns true if all objectives are completed.

members.member: Time limit in seconds. -1 means no limit.
